source.scope: Source archive of the published revision, including frontend build inputs and netlify/functions/api-proxy.mjs.

deployment.evidenceSource: Existing project deployment dashboard and build log inspected by the publishing operator in the authenticated cloud browser.

singleSampleTiming.scope: Client-observed intervals in the initial public GET probe include a synchronous local report checkpoint before fetch. Its cost was not isolated. These values do not measure exclusively network/server time, app-ready time, a cold start, provider generation latency or a controlled before/after comparison.

publicVerification.identityMethod: Match public HTML and JavaScript references to names confirmed in this deployment's build log. The source revision is established by the source archive and deployment evidence, not a public commit endpoint.

checks: Explorar como Visitante opened the application and Conversar opened successfully.
Text composer, Ouvir resposta, Histórico, Novo Chat and text/voice conversation controls displayed.
Voz Rápida and Voz Google selectors were absent from the inspected controls.
Opening the voice conversation displayed the Gemini data consent dialog before capture.
The operator explicitly cancelled consent; the interface reported Envio cancelado and Voz pausada.
Continuar por Texto returned to the text conversation; the application was left in text mode.

predeploymentValidation.notes: These are the existing predeployment results, not newly executed or additional test scenarios.

limitations: The public probe performed GET requests only, including two static JavaScript files. It did not send chat, voice, microphone or WebSocket turns.
The manual UI inspection cancelled voice consent before capture. It does not establish audible voice quality, recognition accuracy or full voice availability.
Local automated voice tests use simulated providers. The separate limited real chat and HTTP speech sample was made against Render and is recorded in postdeploy-render.json.
No controlled before/after performance comparison, physical-device validation or latency guarantee is claimed.

historicalEvidence.policy: Earlier observations are retained as dated snapshots. Their Netlify-pending state is superseded by this deployment record.
